messages:
Sasha: CI red on the snapshot suite for prompt serializer. Several golden tests flipped — looks like punctuation normalization changed (quotes + dashes). failing files under tests/gold/prompt_renderer/. cc @Alex @Mike :eyes:
CI Bot: CI: job build-ml-snapshots #452 failed — 12 failing tests. Logs: https://ci/internal/build-ml-snapshots/452. To rerun: `/rerun build-ml-snapshots`
Alex: Can you paste a tiny diff of one failing golden? helps triage :+1:
Sasha: sure, here's one example diff:
```diff
- rendered: "He said, \"Hello — world.\""
+ rendered: "He said, \u201cHello - world.\u201d"
```
Sasha: note: em-dash became hyphen, straight quotes became curly quotes (smart punctuation).
Mike: that aligns with the normalization change I merged last week — added smart punctuation handling. Could be defaulting to smart=True now. Sasha can you try a local run: `pytest tests/test_prompt_renderer.py::test_complex_quotes -q` and set `GOLDEN_UPDATE=1` if you want to update goldens locally?
Sasha: running now. command I used: `GOLDEN=true pytest tests/test_prompt_renderer.py::test_complex_quotes -q` — reproduced locally with same diff. Full failing snippet attached in the job logs.
Jen: If it's the normalization PR, we shouldn't flip goldens silently. We need a bisect to confirm commit and either revert or gate behind a flag. @Mike can you bisect and report commit?
Mike: starting bisect now: `git bisect start --term-old=good --term-new=bad && git bisect bad && git bisect good v2024-09-01` — will run bisect script that runs the minimal snapshot test. I'll post the commit when found.
CI Bot: Rerun requested by @Sasha: `/rerun build-ml-snapshots` — queued as job 453.
Alex: also let's open a short GH issue to track: "serializer: avoid default smart punctuation for goldens" and add customer impact note.
Mike: bisect result: culprit commit b7a4c3e "normalize punctuation in serializer" (PR #4501). Reverting that commit locally makes the tests pass. I'll open a revert PR and propose a feature flag `smart_punct=false` by default for now so goldens are stable.
Sasha: thanks. leaving snapshots as-is (don't update goldens) until we have a decision. If you open the revert PR, include a unit test asserting previous behavior so this doesn't regress again.
Alex: sounds good. If revert blocks other changes, we can land a short-term revert then re-land behind opt-in. ping here when PR is up. :rocket:
Mike: PR for revert opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4620 — description includes test and flag. Will watch CI.
Sasha: I kicked the rerun — job 453 passed some matrixes but snapshot suite still fails on 453-2 (same). holding until revert merges. Thanks all.
